<documents>
<document id="transfers-link-external">
LinkingˆanˆexternalˆbankˆaccountˆToˆmoveˆmoneyˆbetweenˆTallowbrookˆandˆanˆaccountˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆlinkˆthatˆaccountˆfirst.ˆYouˆcanˆlinkˆitˆinstantlyˆbyˆsigningˆinˆtoˆtheˆotherˆbank,ˆorˆbyˆconfirmingˆtwoˆsmallˆdeposits.ˆ##ˆLinkˆinstantlyˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆLinkedˆaccounts,ˆthenˆAddˆaccount.ˆChooseˆyourˆbankˆandˆsignˆin.ˆMostˆlargeˆbanksˆcanˆbeˆlinkedˆthisˆwayˆinˆunderˆaˆminute.ˆ##ˆLinkˆwithˆsmallˆdepositsˆIfˆyourˆbankˆisn'tˆlisted,ˆenterˆitsˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumber.ˆWeˆsendˆtwoˆsmallˆdeposits,ˆwhichˆarriveˆinˆ1ˆtoˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆEnterˆtheˆtwoˆamountsˆinˆtheˆappˆwithinˆ14ˆdaysˆtoˆfinishˆlinking.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆtheˆlinkˆexpiresˆandˆyouˆneedˆtoˆstartˆagain.ˆ##ˆRulesˆ-ˆTheˆexternalˆaccountˆmustˆbeˆinˆyourˆname.ˆWeˆcan'tˆlinkˆaccountsˆthatˆbelongˆtoˆsomeoneˆelse,ˆincludingˆaˆspouse.ˆ-ˆYouˆcanˆlinkˆupˆtoˆ5ˆexternalˆaccounts.ˆ-ˆNewˆlinkedˆaccountsˆmayˆhaveˆlowerˆtransferˆamountsˆforˆtheˆfirstˆfewˆdaysˆwhileˆweˆconfirmˆthem.ˆYourˆTallowbrookˆroutingˆandˆaccountˆnumbersˆareˆshownˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆifˆtheˆotherˆbankˆasksˆforˆthem.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="account-address-change">
UpdatingˆyourˆaddressˆYouˆcanˆupdateˆyourˆaddressˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆProfile,ˆthenˆPersonalˆdetails.ˆ##ˆProofˆofˆaddressˆSometimesˆweˆcanˆconfirmˆaˆnewˆaddressˆautomatically.ˆIfˆweˆcan't,ˆwe'llˆaskˆyouˆtoˆuploadˆaˆdocumentˆdatedˆwithinˆtheˆlastˆ90ˆdaysˆthatˆshowsˆyourˆnameˆandˆnewˆaddress:ˆ-ˆUtilityˆbillˆ-ˆLeaseˆorˆmortgageˆstatementˆ-ˆBankˆorˆcreditˆcardˆstatementˆ-ˆGovernmentˆletterˆUntilˆit'sˆconfirmed,ˆcardsˆandˆchecksˆstillˆgoˆtoˆyourˆoldˆaddress.ˆ##ˆMovingˆabroadˆWeˆcanˆonlyˆuseˆUSˆresidentialˆaddresses.ˆIfˆyou'reˆmovingˆabroad,ˆtellˆusˆfirst.ˆ##ˆOrderingˆaˆcardˆafterˆmovingˆUpdateˆyourˆaddressˆbeforeˆorderingˆaˆreplacementˆcard.ˆWeˆcan'tˆredirectˆaˆcardˆthat'sˆalreadyˆbeenˆmailed.ˆ##ˆNameˆchangesˆChangingˆyourˆnameˆisˆaˆdifferentˆprocess.ˆSeeˆ"Changingˆyourˆlegalˆname".ˆ##ˆMailˆweˆsendˆWeˆsendˆveryˆlittleˆbyˆpost.ˆCards,ˆandˆaˆcheckˆifˆyouˆcloseˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆaˆlinkedˆexternalˆaccount,ˆgoˆtoˆtheˆaddressˆonˆfile,ˆsoˆkeepˆitˆcurrent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-scams">
CommonˆscamsˆtoˆwatchˆforˆTheseˆareˆtheˆscamsˆweˆseeˆmostˆoften.ˆKnowingˆthemˆisˆtheˆbestˆprotection.ˆ##ˆFakeˆbankˆcallsˆSomeoneˆcallsˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆTallowbrook'sˆfraudˆteam.ˆTheyˆknowˆsomeˆofˆyourˆdetailsˆandˆsayˆyourˆaccountˆisˆatˆrisk.ˆTheyˆaskˆforˆaˆcodeˆorˆaskˆyouˆtoˆmoveˆmoney.ˆThat'sˆaˆscam.ˆWeˆneverˆdoˆthat.ˆ##ˆImpersonatingˆsomeoneˆyouˆknowˆAˆmessageˆfromˆaˆ"familyˆmember"ˆwithˆaˆnewˆnumberˆwhoˆurgentlyˆneedsˆmoney.ˆCallˆthemˆonˆtheirˆoldˆnumberˆbeforeˆyouˆsendˆanything.ˆ##ˆMarketplaceˆandˆrentalˆscamsˆAˆsellerˆasksˆyouˆtoˆpayˆbyˆBrookPayˆorˆwireˆinsteadˆofˆaˆprotectedˆpaymentˆmethod,ˆoftenˆforˆaˆdealˆthatˆseemsˆtooˆgood.ˆBrookPayˆandˆwiresˆcan'tˆbeˆreversed.ˆ##ˆJobˆandˆinvestmentˆscamsˆSomeoneˆoffersˆeasyˆmoneyˆforˆmovingˆfundsˆthroughˆyourˆaccount,ˆorˆpromisesˆguaranteedˆreturns.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆforˆothersˆcanˆgetˆyourˆaccountˆclosed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyou'veˆbeenˆscammed,ˆmessageˆusˆstraightˆaway.ˆTheˆsoonerˆweˆknow,ˆtheˆbetterˆtheˆchanceˆofˆstoppingˆorˆrecoveringˆtheˆmoney,ˆalthoughˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆthat.ˆSeeˆ"Ifˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆscammer".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>

response.text: {"answer":"No. You need to enter the two deposit amounts within 14 days, so after three weeks the link has expired. Start the linking process again in the app: Transfers → Linked accounts → Add account.","citations":["transfers-link-external"],"escalate":false}
